title: timeout x always-verify, serial, deliberately under-powered (4 cells)

config_audit.not_in: run.started payload, which carries no config

spend.prose: Tier 4 combines the two most expensive conditions and is reported at n=4 as a deliberately under-powered probe rather than an estimate. Verification remains an accurate detector under the timeout manifestation -- every one of the 21 worker-result boundaries belonging to a denied worker was flagged and none of the 12 clean ones were, directionally consistent with Tier 2's 94% recall and 4% false-positive rate at n=10 but not readable as a better rate at this sample size. Detection does not translate into recovery: 3 of 4 cells still died on run_timeout with no answer, because the verifier is diagnostic-only and never rewrites a result or re-plans, so the system correctly identifies that its evidence is missing and then runs out of wall clock anyway. The cost is substantial and compounds with the manifestation: verification is 38-46% of each cell's tokens and adds 95% to 209% over the matched Tier 1 timeout/baseline cell, making this the most expensive condition in the section for the least marginal information.

notes: DELIBERATELY UNDER-POWERED AT n=4, and reduced from 10 questions on purpose. This is the most expensive cell per run in the whole section -- timeout dead time plus verifier calls at two boundaries -- and the least likely to show anything the earlier tiers have not: Tier 1 already establishes what the timeout manifestation does to completion, and Tier 2 already measures detection at n=10 under the immediate manifestation. Targets are the 4 section-6 targets with the highest section-5 token ratios (Q114 4.72, Q224 4.06, Q89 3.53, Q95 3.31). NO DETECTION-RATE CONCLUSION SHOULD BE DRAWN FROM n=4 WITHOUT STATING THE n.
Run SERIALLY. Like Tier 1 these are wall-clock boundary cells against run_timeout_seconds: 900, so contention would change the dependent variable.

The matched comparator for marginal verification cost in 8b is Tier 1 (timeout x baseline), not section 5: the manifestation must be held constant for the marginal cost of verification to mean anything.

ADOPTION GATE: adoption is read from Lead model.response text plus worker terminal status, never from complete_task.uncertainties (structurally always empty under persistent denial). The gate was corrected twice during this section, both times for FALSE NEGATIVES: first it required the literal document ID or the substring 'read', which scored SILENT turns like 'The Snoopy worker has failed three times on budget' that name the document by catalog title and by worker; then it lacked any pattern for the timeout manifestation, which scored SILENT turns like 'The Cowboys article workers have timed out six times'. All tiers in this section were regenerated under the final gate.

Single-rep magnitudes, and Tier 3's bound (token deviation median 9.7%, max 51.6%; wall clock median 39.8%, max 83.0%) applies to every number here. At n=4 the detection figures have no confidence interval worth quoting.
